home.question: How many days was your area downwind of a burning landfill?
home.input.label: Address, landmark or PIN code
home.input.offline: Offline sample: choose a station near a site
home.answer: In {year}, {area} was downwind of a detected landfill fire on
home.answer.all: From {from} to {to}, {area} was downwind of a detected landfill fire on
home.answer.empty: No landfill fires were detected within {r} km of this place in {year}.
home.answer.empty.all: No landfill fires were detected within {r} km of this place from {from} to {to}.
home.answer.nofire: Sites within {r} km had {n} fire days in {year}, but the modelled wind did not carry smoke toward this place on any of them.
home.calm: {n} more fire days had calm air (wind below {ws} m/s) near the site, so direction is undefined. They are not counted.
home.notfound: We could not find that place in India. Try a landmark or PIN code.
home.outside: This place is more than {r} km from every site we track. Smoulder covers {sites}.
home.modelled.note: A modelled downwind count, not a measure of exposure.
sub.title: Get a downwind alert
sub.body: When a satellite detects a fire at a site within {r} km and the forecast wind blows toward this place, we email you. Your address is not stored; we keep the location rounded to about 100 m.
sub.sent: Check your inbox: confirm the subscription from Amazon SNS to start alerts.
sub.offline: Alerts need the live service. This is the offline snapshot.
atlas.title: Sites
live.none: No counted detection at any tracked site in the live window.
limits.1: No emissions, tonnes burned or health effects are estimated.
limits.2: Smouldering below the surface is often invisible to satellites.
limits.3: A VIIRS pixel (about 375 m at nadir, larger off-nadir) is larger than parts of the site.
limits.4: Each satellite passes about twice a day; short fires between passes are missed.
limits.5: Cloud and smoke hide fires and imagery.
limits.6: OpenStreetMap coverage has gaps; counts are of mapped features.
limits.7: Modelled wind (9 km grid) cannot resolve street-level flow.
state.error: Live data unavailable. Showing the snapshot from {date}.
state.webgl: 3D is unavailable here; showing a still image of the same scene.
footer.credits: Data: NASA FIRMS · Open-Meteo · Copernicus Sentinel-2 and DEM (AWS Open Data) · WorldPop · © OpenStreetMap contributors
home.kicker: A public fire record for India's landfills
record.title: Every day a satellite saw a landfill burn.
record.stat.days.method: Counted VIIRS detections (Tier A/B, nominal or high confidence), one fire day per site per IST date.
record.stat.unreported: of those {n} fire days had no news report we could find
record.stat.unreported.method: A fire day counts as reported if a linked news report covers that date ±1 day.
record.stat.people: lakh people live within 1 km of these sites
record.stat.people.method: WorldPop 2020 100 m grid summed inside each site boundary buffered by 1 km; rings do not overlap.
record.aria: Timeline of {n} detected fire days at {sites} landfill sites from {from} to {to}.
record.legend.height: height: detections that day · glow: fire radiative power
home.sub: Satellites see the fires at nine landfills in five cities. The wind decides where the smoke goes. Type a place to see how often it was downwind.
